info.description: Complete registered control-plane HTTP wire surface, including legacy v1. Production requires mutual TLS and a tenant bearer token. x-preview-origin: A separate TLS/HTTP1 browser origin transparently proxies authenticated application HTTP/WebSocket. Upstream application bodies/statuses are not control API schemas. See preview-v1 protocol.
x-runtime-validation: JSON schemas describe the wire contract. Byte quotas, canonical/confined paths, signed features, tenant policy, readiness, current lifetimes and resource limits remain mandatory server checks. GET routes also accept HEAD without a response body; framework canonical redirects remain standard HTTP.
